summary: Flight Status Dashboard — Status Indicator Panel
description: As an operations controller, I want to see a real-time status indicator panel on the flight dashboard so that I can monitor active flight statuses at a glance.

acs.text: The status panel displays a colored indicator for each active flight: green for On Time, yellow for Delayed, red for Cancelled.
Each indicator includes the flight number and estimated departure time.
Clicking an indicator opens a detail drawer with full flight information.
The panel refreshes automatically every 60 seconds without a full page reload.

sections.content: The status panel is located in the top-right quadrant of the dashboard. Each indicator is a rounded card 120px wide. The detail drawer slides in from the right.
